content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 11.1 sat in walk-away territory — immediate cessation of all assistance plus permanent deletion of Customer Data with no export or migration support — and contradicted the more favourable mechanics in 11.2 (30-day, machine-readable return) and 11.3 (officer-certified deletion after Customer confirms return).

**Redline (preferred level, two surgical replacements):**
1. 11.1 rewritten to give up to six months of transition assistance on expiry or termination of the Agreement or any Order Form, at Vendor's then-current rates (removing the deletion/no-export language).
2. 11.2's trigger extended so the 30-day return runs from expiry or termination as well as Customer's request; all other wording preserved verbatim.

Machine-readable format (11.2) and certified deletion after return (11.3) were mapped as already met, so no new language was added for them.
